First, notice that

$$
c=2i-5j+k=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

To compute $4c-3d,$ we need to perform the required operations with each component separately:

$$
\begin{aligned}4c-3d & =4\cdot [\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5 \\ 1\end{aligned}]-3\cdot [\begin{aligned}4 \\ 1 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -20 \\ 4\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}12 \\ 3 \\ -6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ -23 \\ 10\end{aligned}] \\  & =⟨-4,-23,10⟩\end{aligned}
$$
